fusions.name: Glowing Gauntlet
fusions.desc: A blow with a heated gauntlet that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to set it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Furnace Vent
fusions.desc: You vent the heat built up inside your plate, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Red-Hot Plate
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take goes back to the attacker, and each attacker is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Forge-Lined Cuirass
fusions.desc: Conjures a hot-lined cuirass over you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your maximum health rises by 8, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
